rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: PreClick provides URL preflight scanning for autonomous agent workflows. It analyzes target URLs for malicious content, phishing attempts, and other security threats before navigation. The service also supports intent-aware scanning, where agents can specify their browsing purpose to detect misaligned destinations. Hosted at preclick.ai with a free trial tier of 100 requests per day.
